gates.description: No hardcoded secrets in CI/CD or IaC files
Liveness and readiness health checks must be defined
Monitoring and alerting configuration must exist
Rollback strategy must be defined for deployments
CPU and memory resource limits must be set for containers

anti_patterns.description: Servers configured manually with undocumented changes
A CI/CD pipeline that takes 45 minutes, fails randomly, and nobody understands
Hundreds of alerts, most ignorable, so real alerts get missed
One person who knows how to deploy with 47 manual steps
Production diverges from staging because of hotfixes and manual changes

escalation_triggers: Production is down and automated rollback failed
A security scan reveals a critical vulnerability in production infrastructure
Cloud provider experiencing an outage affecting the deployment region
Cost spike detected (>2x normal daily spend) with no known cause
Pipeline broken on main branch for >2 hours, blocking all deployments

output_certifications: CI/CD pipeline configuration exists and runs on every PR
No hardcoded secrets in any configuration files
Monitoring and alerting configured for error rate and latency
Resource limits (CPU, memory) set for all containers
